ctx.x: I say, so and the procedure of our doing these recordings -- we acquired some new youngsters, which was Jonathan Nichols, see. That was our -- Public Tap was our last protege I like to say, because -- and then I had to be a judge one time at a dance contest, and I acquired one.
Who was John -- Jonathan Nichols a protege of?
Pete Nugent, of Peaches and Duke. See, that's the Dancing Doughboys.
